_comment: Pre-existing architecture violations, each owned by a phase that removes it. Entries print as WARN and do not fail the build. Regenerate with: python scripts/arch_guard.py --baseline. Adding an entry by hand requires a phase reference in its reason.

violations.R1 governance/config_governance.py:_fern: lazy cipher handle, not state; Phase 0.3 moves it behind the vault
violations.R1 governance/leader_election.py:_electi: process-local lease client; the lease itself is in Redis
violations.R1 governance/readiness.py:_ready: per-process load latch for the middleware caches; budget and policies stay in the DB and are reloaded on restart (SECURITY-DEBT-01)
violations.R1 governance/readiness.py:_retry_at: per-process retry back-off only; it never grants access (SECURITY-DEBT-01)
violations.R1 governance/readiness.py:_locks: per-process single-flight locks for the load (SECURITY-DEBT-01)
